data.name: Repl_CellCount_Other
data.comment: Counts the cells in a notebook, dropped into another message. Used for every count other than 1. A language with one form for both translates this the same as the entry above.

data.name: Repl_Description
data.value: Start an interactive Verso REPL in the terminal.
data.comment: Summary of the repl command in 'verso --help'. REPL is the usual name for a prompt that reads, runs, and prints; keep the English acronym where that is what practitioners say.

data.name: Repl_ExecutionError
data.comment: Printed when running a cell failed before the kernel could report it. {0} is the reason.

data.name: Repl_HeaderExtensionCount
data.comment: Value against the extensions label in the starting banner. {0} is how many were loaded.

data.name: Repl_HeaderExtensions
data.comment: Label in the banner printed when the REPL starts. The four labels line up, so keep them close in length to each other.

data.name: Repl_HeaderHint
data.comment: Last line of the starting banner. {0} and {1} are .help and .exit, typed at a keyboard, and are the same in every language.

data.name: Repl_HeaderKernel
data.comment: Label in the banner printed when the REPL starts. The four labels line up, so keep them close in length to each other.

data.name: Repl_HeaderNotebook
data.comment: Label in the banner printed when the REPL starts. The four labels line up, so keep them close in length to each other.

data.name: Repl_HeaderTheme
data.comment: Label in the banner printed when the REPL starts. The four labels line up, so keep them close in length to each other.

data.name: Repl_MarkerDefault
data.comment: Stands in for the theme when none was chosen. Written in angle brackets so it cannot be mistaken for the name of one.

data.name: Repl_MarkerNone
data.comment: Stands in for the kernel or the layout when none is chosen. Written in angle brackets so it cannot be mistaken for the name of one.

data.name: Repl_MarkerScratch
data.comment: Stands in for the file name when the session was started without one. Written in asterisks so it cannot be mistaken for a path.

data.name: Repl_MetaCommandError
data.comment: {0} is the command's name, {1} the reason it failed.

data.name: Repl_OptExecute
data.value: When combined with <notebook>, executes all loaded cells before handing control to the prompt.
data.comment: Help for --execute. <notebook> names the file argument as the help text spells it.

data.name: Repl_OptHistory
data.value: Path to the prompt history file. Use 'none' to disable persistent history.
data.comment: Help for --history. 'none' is typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Repl_OptKernel
data.value: Active kernel for the first cell. Matched against ILanguageKernel.KernelId case-insensitively. Can be changed at runtime with .kernel.
data.comment: Help for --kernel. ILanguageKernel.KernelId is an identifier and .kernel is typed at a keyboard; both stay as written.

data.name: Repl_OptLayout
data.value: Default layout id, passed to .export as ActiveLayoutId unless the command overrides it.
data.comment: Help for --layout. .export is typed at a keyboard and ActiveLayoutId is an identifier; both stay as written.

data.name: Repl_OptListKernels
data.comment: Help for --list-kernels.

data.name: Repl_OptListThemes
data.comment: Help for --list-themes.

data.name: Repl_OptNoColor
data.value: Disable ANSI styling. Output is plain UTF-8 text.
data.comment: Help for --no-color. ANSI and UTF-8 are standard names and stay as written.

data.name: Repl_OptPlain
data.value: Force the line-oriented fallback prompt, bypassing PrettyPrompt even when the terminal would support it.
data.comment: Help for --plain. PrettyPrompt is a library name and stays as written.

data.name: Repl_OptPreserveFormat
data.value: When the loaded notebook is .ipynb, .save (no arg) writes back to .ipynb instead of converting to .verso. Cell outputs are preserved.
data.comment: Help for --preserve-format. .save is typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Repl_OptTheme
data.value: Active theme for output rendering. DisplayName case-insensitive with ThemeId fallback.
data.comment: Help for --theme. DisplayName and ThemeId are identifiers and stay as written.

data.name: Repl_PriorExecutionFailed
data.comment: Stands in for the reason when a notebook records that a cell failed but not why.

data.name: Repl_ScratchTitle
data.comment: Title given to a session started without a file, and saved into the notebook. {0} is the date and time it started.

data.name: Repl_TypeHelpForList
data.comment: Follows the message above. {0} is .help, typed at a keyboard, and is the same in every language.

data.name: Repl_UnknownMetaCommand
data.comment: A meta-command is one of the dot-prefixed commands the REPL answers itself. {0} is what was typed after the dot.

data.name: Repl_UnsavedCells
data.comment: Printed when something would discard work. Followed by the line below.

data.name: Repl_UnsavedHint
data.value: Run {0} first, or {1} again to discard.
data.comment: Follows the message above. {0} and {1} are commands typed at a keyboard and are the same in every language.

data.name: Repl_Usage
data.comment: Printed when a REPL command was typed wrongly. {0} is the shape it should have taken, which is typed at a keyboard and is the same in every language.

data.name: Root_Description
data.value: Verso CLI: execute, serve, and convert Verso notebooks.
data.comment: First line of 'verso --help'. Verso is the product's name and is the same in every language.

data.name: Root_UnhandledError
data.comment: Last resort, printed when a command failed in a way nothing else caught. {0} is the reason.

data.name: Run_ArgNotebook
data.comment: Help for the file argument of run. The extensions are the same in every language.

data.name: Run_CellCompleted
data.comment: Progress line, only with --verbose. {2} is a number of seconds, {3} the recorded status, which is an identifier such as Success.

data.name: Run_Description
data.value: Execute a notebook headlessly and stream cell outputs.
data.comment: Summary of the run command in 'verso --help'.

data.name: Run_ExecutingCell
data.comment: Progress line, only with --verbose. {0} is the cell's position, {1} how many there are, {2} its language, which is an identifier such as csharp.

data.name: Run_InvalidCellSelector
data.value: Invalid cell selector '{0}'. Use a 0-based index or a cell GUID.
data.comment: {0} is what the reader passed to --cell.

data.name: Run_InvalidParamFormat
data.comment: {0} is what the reader typed. 'name=value' describes the shape it should have and stays as written.

data.name: Run_LoadingThirdParty
data.value: Loading third-party extensions from '{0}'. These extensions are auto-approved for headless execution.
data.comment: {0} is a directory path.

data.name: Run_OptCell
data.value: Execute only the specified cell (index or GUID). May be repeated.
data.comment: Help for --cell.

data.name: Run_OptFailFast
data.value: Stop execution on the first cell failure.
data.comment: Help for --fail-fast.

data.name: Run_OptFailOnStderr
data.value: Treat anything a cell writes to standard error as a failure. Off by default, because progress bars, logging, and warnings are normally written there by programs that are succeeding. Use this to make a pipeline strict about them.
data.comment: Help for --fail-on-stderr.

data.name: Run_OptIgnoreViewState
data.value: Ignore per-cell verso:ui.outputVisibility and verso:ui.inputCollapsed metadata; show all outputs in full.
data.comment: Help for --ignore-view-state. The two metadata keys are identifiers and stay as written.

data.name: Run_OptIncludeMarkdown
data.value: Include markdown and HTML cell content in terminal output.
data.comment: Help for --include-markdown.

data.name: Run_OptInteractive
data.value: Prompt for missing required parameters on stdin instead of failing.
data.comment: Help for --interactive.

data.name: Run_OptKernel
data.comment: Help for --kernel.

data.name: Run_OptOutput
data.value: Output format: text, json, or none.
data.comment: Help for --output. The three values are typed at a keyboard and stay as written.

data.name: Run_OptOutputFile
data.value: Write output to a file instead of stdout. Implies --output json if no format specified.
data.comment: Help for --output-file.

data.name: Run_OptParam
data.value: Set a notebook parameter (format: name=value). May be repeated.
data.comment: Help for --param. 'name=value' describes what is typed and stays as written.

data.name: Run_OptSave
data.value: Save updated outputs back to the notebook file after execution.
data.comment: Help for --save.

data.name: Run_OptShowParameters
data.value: Show resolved parameter values in terminal output.
data.comment: Help for --show-parameters.

data.name: Run_OptTimeout
data.value: Maximum total execution time in seconds.
data.comment: Help for --timeout.

data.name: Run_OptTrustLocal
data.value: Allow loading assemblies generated during the current session without consent.
data.comment: Help for --trust-local-assemblies.

data.name: Run_OptVerbose
data.value: Print cell execution progress to stderr.
data.comment: Help for --verbose.

data.name: Run_RefusingSessionExtension
data.value: Refusing session-generated extension '{0}'. Use --trust-local-assemblies to allow.
data.comment: {0} is a package name.

data.name: Run_UnsupportedFormat
data.comment: {0} is a file extension.

data.name: Serve_ArgNotebook
data.value: Optional notebook to open on startup.
data.comment: Help for the file argument of serve.

data.name: Serve_Description
data.value: Launch the Verso Blazor application as a local web server.
data.comment: Summary of the serve command in 'verso --help'.

data.name: Serve_OptNoBrowser
data.value: Do not open a browser tab on startup.
data.comment: Help for --no-browser.

data.name: Serve_OptNoHttps
data.comment: Help for --no-https.

data.name: Serve_OptPort
data.comment: Help for --port.

data.name: Serve_OptPreserveFormat
data.value: When a loaded .ipynb notebook is saved, write back to .ipynb instead of converting to .verso. Cell outputs are preserved.
data.comment: Help for --preserve-format.

data.name: Serve_OptVerbose
data.comment: Help for --verbose.

data.name: Serve_PressCtrlC
data.comment: Follows the line above. Ctrl+C is a key combination and is the same in every language.

data.name: Serve_Running
data.comment: Printed once the server is listening. {0} is a web address.

data.name: Serve_StartFailed
data.comment: {0} is the reason.

data.name: Serve_VerboseExtensions
data.comment: Startup detail, only with --verbose. {0} is a directory path.

data.name: Serve_VerboseNotebook
data.comment: Startup detail, only with --verbose. {0} is a file path.

data.name: Table_Command
data.comment: Column heading over the REPL commands listed by .help. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Description
data.comment: Column heading over a line describing the row. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_DisplayName
data.comment: Column heading over the name a kernel shows itself under. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Extensions
data.comment: Column heading over the file extensions a format is read from, such as .verso. Not the add-ons, which have their own heading. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Format
data.comment: Column heading over the name of an export format or a notebook format. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Id
data.comment: Column heading over an extension's identifier. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Kind
data.comment: Column heading over whether a theme is light or dark. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Language
data.comment: Column heading over the language a kernel runs. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Name
data.comment: Column heading over a variable's or a formatter's name. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Preview
data.comment: Column heading over the first part of a variable's value. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Priority
data.comment: Column heading over the order formatters are tried in. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Status
data.comment: Column heading over whether an extension loaded. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Theme
data.comment: Column heading over a theme's name. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Type
data.comment: Column heading over the type of a variable, as in what kind of value it holds. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.

data.name: Table_Version
data.comment: Column heading over an extension's version number. Kept short: columns are padded to their widest entry.
